name: Phenyltrimethoxysilane
description: Phenyltrimethoxysilane (CAS 2996-92-1 ) is an organosilane monomer used to introduce phenyl functionality into silicone networks and inorganic surfaces. It acts as a surface modifier, crosslinker, and polymerization building block across coatings and electronics. In silicone resin synthesis, it contributes phenyl groups that improve thermal stability and compatibility with organic polymers. This makes it a preferred monomer for high-performance coatings and encapsulants in various industrial sectors. Electronics manufacturers use it to treat fillers and substrates, improving adhesion and moisture resistance in encapsulation compounds. It is also frequently utilized in underfill formulations to ensure long-term component reliability. In adhesives and sealants, it functions as a crosslinking agent that enhances bond durability to glass, metal, and ceramic surfaces. This versatility allows for stronger structural integrity in demanding environmental conditions. Plastics compounders incorporate it as a coupling agent to improve filler-matrix adhesion in reinforced polymer systems. This process optimizes the mechanical properties and chemical resistance of the final composite materials. The product is supplied as a liquid and is available in technical grade for industrial synthesis and surface treatment applications. It is handled according to standard chemical safety protocols for organosilicon compounds. Purity specifications typically range from 97% to 99%+, with higher-purity grades used in electronics and specialty polymer applications.
